verdict.rationale: The client source is publicly readable in the anyproto/anytype-ts GitHub repository, and the vendor docs call the agents-skill toolkit open-source. However, a community report says the main app uses a source-available license, not an open one, and nothing in the evidence shows an OSI-approved license for the core product. Missing for 10: confirmation of an open (OSI-approved) license for the core app and middleware, first-party license documentation, and independent corroboration that the full source is published.
